summary.text: The three great worlds in Crazed Demon Cave's eighth layer are fusing into one, with many small worlds following beside them.

claims.text: Each world is like a bubble. The three great worlds are the largest bubbles, green, yellow, and red. They are joint together at the center. Smaller bubbles are linked to their surface. The connecting area of the three worlds is filled with corpses. Yellow Earth Great World is Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable’s. Green Lotus Great World is the Dao field of Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable. Reckless Savage left the third of the three.

The three great worlds were made one after another. Savage Wilderness Great World had the longest history. Green Lotus Great World was second. Yellow Earth Great World was the most recent, because Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable was the most recent venerable.

A large number of Gu cultivators died. Their sacrifice made the three worlds grow larger with an increasing number of stable dao marks. The more who died, the more the boundaries of the three great worlds faded, and the larger the connected area became.

Mutant Gu Immortals whose small worlds were still moving, and had not landed near the three great worlds yet, say that because this change occurred in the void, the unification of the worlds cannot be avoided, so they need to find a good allegiance.

The fusion of Green Lotus Great World, Yellow Earth Great World, and Savage Wilderness Great World was getting deeper. Only a small part of the boundary walls remained to obstruct their connection. All of the small worlds had already fused into the three great worlds. Savage Wilderness Great World gained the greatest benefits and the most people, from Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s heaven and earth luck method drawing most of the small worlds toward it.
Crazed Demon formation still needed the great worlds to act as clues and fuel. If this place was destroyed, it would trigger Limitless Demon Venerable’s retaliative measures.

Lu Wei Yin says Star Constellation will definitely unite the three great worlds and destroy Paradise Earth’s tomb. The three great worlds were rapidly melting. The boundaries had already shrunk by thirty percent. The void in the eighth layer, originally vast and infinite, had its boundary sticking close to the bubbles of the three great worlds.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable returned and set up a formation. Heavenly Court’s Gu Immortals split and invaded Savage Wilderness Great World and Yellow Earth Great World, setting a sub-formation after occupying each territory. The sub-formations resonated with the main formation she controlled. Green Lotus Great World expanded continuously as it absorbed the other two great worlds into its territory. The three great worlds finally merged.

A storm covered the whole world. Wind blew like the qi tides of five regions, merging the primeval energy of the great world and distributing it evenly. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable says Limitless Demon Venerable’s heaven and earth refinement method has already reached the peak, and that if she is not wrong, this wind will continue to grow until it becomes the winds of assimilation. She helped the great worlds unite and gained many insights from this. She says the three worlds have merged, the outcome has been decided. Heavenly Court united the three worlds and got hold of massive clues and fuel.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable collected the main formation, and Heavenly Court’s immortals collected the sub-formations. Under her influence, the melting speed of the eighth layer’s great world sped up by several times. Heavenly Court immortals say they will unite the five regions just like Crazed Demon Cave’s three worlds.
Star Constellation Immortal Venerable says that before the three worlds united, Limitless’ eternal life result was still far away, and everyone needed to wait.
